snippet.title: Early Access Trailer - KILL THE WITCH
snippet.description:
" That’s why I’m here—to smash it all.
Till not even a speck of dust is left. "
 
In an age when humanity gave up on happiness—just to escape unhappiness—and became nothing but bugs. This is the tale of a witch who grips her baseball bat tight... and smashes everything in her path.

-----

February 17, 2026, 6:00 PM (PST) 
February 17, 2026, 9:00 PM (ET) 
February 18, 2026, 2:00 AM (UTC) 
February 18, 2026, 3:00 AM (CET)
KILL THE WITCH Early Access begins!
The Early Access version includes 2 stages out of a total of 6.

-----

Steam : https://store.steampowered.com/app/2878760/KILL_THE_WITCH/
X : https://x.com/snakeeaglegame
Discord : https://discord.gg/Cb4qhPrbNV
Instagram : https://www.instagram.com/snakeeaglegame/

Director : ASO
Develop : ASO, HongRyeol
Art : ASO, Kong Ji Hyeon
Soundtrack : Misty (https://www.youtube.com/@misty_studio)
